_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in ntfyTopic. rcon password auto-reads from dedicated.cfg if left blank. Configure ntfyTopic and/or discordWebhooks - at least one transport is required.
_discordPrivacy: it: the joins channel may be PUBLIC and carries FULL detail - city, region, ping, lifetime connect count - which is MORE than the public website shows (activity.json is capped at name + 2-letter country). That is deliberate for a small community server where players know each other. It is a per-server call: on a larger/anonymous server, route joins to a private channel instead, or add a public-category redaction. No IPs or GUIDs are ever in an alert either way.
_discord: OPTIONAL second transport. One WEBHOOK URL per channel (Discord: Channel > Edit Channel > Integrations > Webhooks > New Webhook > Copy Webhook URL). Every alert fans out to ntfy AND Discord; either one alone works fine. Categories route to channels: joins = GF-JoinNotify, alerts = GF-Watchdog, security = GF-SecurityWatch. An unset category falls back to 'default'; leave 'default' blank too and that category is skipped. THE URL IS A CREDENTIAL - anyone holding it can post to that channel as you. This file is gitignored and the pre-commit hook blocks a webhook literal.
_notifyIssues: Red alert when the status poll can't reach the server (edge-triggered, after 3 straight failures) + a green one on recovery. GF-Watchdog alerts on health too, so a real outage buzzes once from each - set false to leave that to the watchdog alone.
_connectCount: End a join alert with the player's lifetime connect count ('7th connect' / 'first connect'), counted per GUID from the storage\t5\logs\players_*.log day-files conn_logger writes. Omitted entirely when there are no day-files.
